main_text.p: Hithp. Part. וּמִתְנַקֵּם Et ulcifcentem fe, Ultorem fui, Pfal. 8.3. Futur. תִּתְנַקֵּם[?] Ultionem fumeret, Jer.5.9.
נָקָם m. Ultio, Vindicta, Ezech.25.12. Conftr. נְקַם בְּרִית Ultionem faederis, Lev.26.25.
נִקְמָה f. Idem: Pfal.149.7. Conftr. נִקְמַת דָּם Ultionem fanguinis, Num.31.3. Aff. נִקְמָתְךָ Ultionem tuam, Jer.11.20. Plural. נְקָמוֹת Ultiones, Pfal.18.48.

נָקַע Luxare, Recedere, Divelli: & Metaphoricè de Anima dicitur: Conftruitur cum Præpofitione מִן. Præter. נִקְעָה נַפְשִׁי מֵעַל אֲחוֹתָהּ Luxata eft anima mea à forore ejus, Ezech.23.18. id eft, tanquam luxatum & elifum membrum recesfit ab ea. Idem eft cum יָקַע.

נָקַף Excidit, Concidit: Futur. יִנְקְפוּ חַגִּים[?] Festa excidant, Jefa.29.1. id eft, facrificia festorum mactent: Et intransitivè, juxta Ab.Efram, Excidentur, hoc eft, יִפָּסְקוּ Ceffabunt. Pih. Præter. נִקַּף Et excidet, Amputabit, Jefa.10.34. נִקְּפוּ אֵת Conciderint, Perfoderint hoc, Job.19.v.26. Hiph. Futur. אַל תַּקִּיפוּ Ne circumcidite, Lev.19.27. Convenit cum קָף.
נָקֵף m. Strictura, id eft, Olearum extrema decussio, & quasi Excifio, Jefa.17.6.
נֶקֶב m. Foramen, Caverna: בְּנֶקֶב הַסֶּלַע In foramine petra, Jer.13.4. Plural.Constr. וּבִנְקֵבֵי Et in foraminibus, Jefa.7.19. וּמִנִּקְבֵי הַסְּלָעִים Et de foraminibus petrarum, Jerem.16.16.

נָקַר Effodit, Perfodit: Infinit. לְנָקֹר לָכֶם In effodiendo vobis, 1.Sam.11.2. Futur. יִקְרוּ Effodient illum, Proverb.30.17. Pih. Præter. נִקַּר עַצְמִי[?] Offa mea perfodit, Job.30.17. Futur. תִּנְקֹר Effodies, Numer.16.14. וַיִּנְקְרוּ Et effoderunt, Jud.16.21. Pyh.Præter. נִקְרְתֶּם Effossi estis, Jesa.51.1.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms are hard to read at this scan resolution; doubtful forms are marked [?]. The first Hebrew form in the first line (after "Futur.") and the Hebrew after "Pih. Præter." in the נקר entry are the least certain. The running head and catchword are in Hebrew letters as printed.
